Most physics and astronomy summer research programs for undergraduates open
in November and close between January and early February. This page lists
them in one place, soonest deadline first, with who can apply and when each
entry was last checked.

The program's own page is always the authority. Deadlines move, and funding
for some programs is not settled until spring. Every entry links to its
program and says the date I last checked it. If something here is wrong or
missing, email me at [s.stockton@tcu.edu](mailto:s.stockton@tcu.edu).

## Other lists worth checking

- [NSF REU site search](https://www.nsf.gov/funding/initiatives/reu/search).
  Every currently funded NSF REU site in every field, searchable by research
  area. No deadlines.
- [NSF ETAP](https://etap.nsf.gov). The application portal most NSF REU sites
  now use. One account covers many programs.
- [AAS Division for Planetary Sciences REU list](https://dps.aas.org/education/reu-programs).
  Planetary science programs in the U.S., Canada and abroad.
- [So you want to apply for an REU](http://astrobites.org/2013/01/05/so-you-want-to-apply-for-an-reu-heres-how/),
  from Astrobites. Written for astronomy, useful for any science REU.
